sources.entry: The Azure Podcast: Episode 227 - Azure SRE

summary.name: The Azure Podcast: Episode 227 - Azure SRE
summary.one_liner: A podcast episode in which Azure SRE team Principal Software Engineer Richard Clawson explains how his team keeps Azure running reliably, plus a roundup of Azure news from April 2019.
use_cases: Learn how Microsoft's Azure SRE team keeps Azure reliable
Listen to a podcast on site reliability engineering at scale
Catch up on Azure product updates from April 2019
Find the Azure IoT serverless hackathon announcement
summary.what_it_does: The page is a podcast episode summary featuring Principal Software Engineer Richard Clawson from the Azure SRE team discussing how the team keeps Azure running reliably. It links to the episode's MP3 media file. The page also includes a list of other Azure updates, covering standard public IP addresses, Global VNet Peering availability, SQL Data Warehouse Gen2 general availability, an Azure IoT on Serverless hackathon, AzCopy on Linux general availability, PyTorch 1.0 support, Azure Marketplace new offers, and Microsoft Build.
notable: Interview with an Azure SRE team engineer on operating Azure reliably
Includes a roundup of Azure product news from April 2019
Hackathon offering a $10,000 cash prize for the top serverless IoT solution
caveats: Page is a podcast episode summary; the page text does not describe the episode's detailed content beyond the one-line blurb
Some updates listed (e.g., Global VNet Peering exclusions, hackathon) are time-bound and may be outdated
